grammar_contract.input: An ordinary parse-that child ParserState at a source-native UTF-16 offset corresponding to one retained CSS-preprocessed position or EOF, with any predecessor value and any valid tested diagnostic profile.
grammar_contract.operation: Inspect no more than the next three positions through direct parse-that terminals/combinators. Return true exactly for digit, sign+digit, dot+digit, or sign+dot+digit; otherwise false.
grammar_contract.composition: Both lanes are binding: direct parser.parser(state), and string(prefix).map(variedPredecessor).next(candidate).skip(string(continuation)).
grammar_contract.state_identity: The raw child must return the identical ParserState object received; the ordinary parent must retain its own input state identity.
grammar_contract.source_identity: Preserve ParserState.src own-property presence and exact string identity/value in both success and failure recognition paths.
grammar_contract.consumption: Always succeed, replace the predecessor with one boolean, consume zero UTF-16 code units, and leave the following grammar at the candidate offset.
grammar_contract.diagnostics: Under explicit package diagnostics-disabled and diagnostics-enabled modes, preserve furthest, expected own-property presence, expected array identity and ordered values, suggestions array identity and each entry identity/fields, and secondarySpans array identity and each entry identity/fields. Preserve the global diagnostics mode.
diagnostic_profiles: undefined expected with multiple diagnostics before
grammar_contract.diagnostic_sandbox: Recognition uses direct core combinators. A candidate-local Parser wrapper may snapshot and restore only offset/value/error and diagnostic bookkeeping around speculative recognition. Its exact work is candidate cost. It may not import diagnostics, change global mode, inspect or derive state.src, classify source manually, advance an imperative cursor, or feed a token/CST layer.
grammar_contract.preprocessing: ASCII +, -, ., and digits are unchanged by preprocessing. Raw and preprocessed truth is asserted only at explicitly mapped corresponding retained positions/EOF. CRLF's eliminated LF interior is excluded and must never be supplied by the future source-map dependency.
grammar_contract.work_bound: Worst-case O(1) time and space; inspect at most three positions; no whole-number/exponent run, substring/CST/token materialization, imperative loop, balanced scanner, or broad remainder capture.

candidate_generation.lineage_accounting: H/B/S may converge on one conservative branch lineage; D and R are two independently constrained constructions. Five isolated authors therefore guarantee at least three material lineages or the feature returns to formation.
candidate_generation.isolation: No author sees another candidate, hidden bytes, benchmark results, or cross-seat design notes before all five exact candidate identities close.
candidate_generation.candidate_source_gate: No candidate source may exist until a manifest binds this immutable precursor and its separate holdout receipt, two fresh independent boundary challenges ACCEPT, and one root gestalt ACCEPTS.

post_candidate_adjudication.quintet: Five independent skeptics each challenge every exact candidate across correctness, CSS fidelity, state/diagnostic preservation, idiomatic parse-that construction, anti-scanner policy, modular ownership, LOC/parsimony, work bound, and performance evidence. No axis is partitioned away.
post_candidate_adjudication.triumvirate: After quintet repairs/replays, three independent adjudicators receive identical exact-byte candidates and evidence. They must converge on one winner or an explicit composition without inventing a fourth opaque implementation.
post_candidate_adjudication.integration: Only the exact triumvirate-selected overlay may be promoted; full-ledger incompleteness still withholds feature apotheosis.

benchmark.peer_credit: H/B/S/D/R only; regex/prior-parser peer-beating remains an integrated public-door obligation.

promotion.human_gate: The AST verifier is necessary but not sufficient; all five skeptics inspect exact bytes for aliases, indirection, recursion, source derivation, and contrived grammar.
